title: Dubai Square Business District: The address of ambition
summary: A new commercial and office district of 300,000 square metres, with a total development value of AED 12 billion
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Dubai, United Arab Emirates – The world has seen business districts. It has never seen this. Rising beside Dubai Square in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, a new commercial and office district of 300,000 square metres, with a total development value of AED 12 billion, is set to become the most connected, most coveted and most extraordinary place to work on the planet. The new Dubai Creek Tower, envisioned as an iconic global landmark, will give this address a defining presence on the world stage.

Two metro stations at the site. Offices plugged straight into them. A mall unlike any ever built at the front door. Four hotels, three urban parks and a city of 200,000 residents within reach. This is not an office address. It is the centre of gravity of Dubai's next era, and every company that matters will want to be in it.

Mohamed Alabbar, founder of Emaar, said: "Some places are built for business. This place was built for ambition. When the history of Dubai’s next chapter is written, it will be written from these towers."

The vision: a skyline that commands attention

At the centre of Dubai Creek Harbour sits Dubai Square, and wrapped around it rises 300,000 sqm of premium commercial and office space: a business district conceived not as a cluster of buildings, but as a single statement of intent.

This is where Dubai's renewed pulsing heart beats loudest. Look down from above and the plan reads like a compass: avenues radiating from Icon Plaza, the creek glittering to the west, green corridors threading through every block. Every line on the map leads here.

The office towers frame the square on every side. Step outside your lobby and you are in the centre of everything: the mall, the metro, the hotels, the parks, the promenade. No commute between meetings. No compromise between work and life. Just one extraordinary address.

Dubai Creek Tower an iconic new global landmark

The new Dubai Creek Tower is envisioned as an iconic global landmark and a defining expression of Dubai’s ambition. Together with Dubai Square, it will give Dubai Creek Harbour a distinctive identity recognised around the world. For companies based here, the tower will bring a powerful sense of place: an internationally recognisable setting for their own next chapter.

Two metro stations. Offices plugged straight in.

Most business districts are near a metro. This one is built on top of it. Two metro stations serve the district directly, and the office buildings are linked straight into them. Your team steps off the train, crosses a climate-controlled link and arrives in the lobby; no car park, no taxi queue, no midday heat.

And the station itself is a landmark. Dubai Creek Harbour's Iconic Metro Station, the highest metro station in the world, rises in soaring golden fins above the creek. It is the kind of front door that tells every client, every candidate and every investor exactly what kind of company works here.

The network goes further. Across Dubai Creek Harbour, 3 metro stations, 17 bus stops and a 7 km Discovery Loop knit the whole city together. Your talent can live anywhere in Dubai and still be at their desk without ever touching a steering wheel.

Dubai Square: a mall like no other, at your front door

The world's great malls ask you to visit. Dubai Square invites you to belong. Set to impress the world, it is technologically advanced and ahead of its time: flagship retail, hospitality and entertainment beneath a sculptural, daylit canopy of golden shells.

Unlike a traditional enclosed mall, Dubai Square extends into the city. Its boulevards spill out into the streets where your offices stand, so lunch, a client dinner or a flagship boutique is never more than a few steps away. It brings together:

  •  Drive-through shopping for the ultimate in convenience
  • An outdoor retail concept that blurs mall and city
  • Multiple entrances and exits and a welcoming arrival experience
  • Sustainable initiatives built into its DNA
  • Direct opening onto Icon Plaza, the ceremonial heart of the distric
  • Direct connectivity to the Iconic Metro Station

Shopping, dining, entertainment, hospitality, residences and offices, all woven into one living district. For the people who work here, Dubai Square is not a destination. It is the neighbourhood.

A city built around your office

Great companies need more than floor plates. They need a world around them. Dubai Creek Harbour delivers one, on a scale few cities on earth can match.

Hotels for every visiting CEO. Four hotels stand around Dubai Square itself, and eight across the masterplan. Your guests land, check in and walk to your boardroom.

Parks at every turn. Three park "hearts" sit inside the district, part of 15 parks, 4 ecological green corridors and 13% open space across the masterplan. Sidr Square, Pearl Park, Cloud Gate Park, Lake Park and more are linked by green and retail axes that carry the energy of the mall out into the streets.

Residences for 200,000 people. More than 200 residential towers and 75,500 homes surround the district, with residential plots just a 5-minute walk from the mall. Your people can live where they work, supported by 7 schools, 14 nurseries, 2 hospitals and 25 clinics, 11 mosques and 70+ community shops.

The waterfront. A 4.5 km promenade and a 600 m urban beach line the creek, home to 450 species of flora and fauna, and the most iconic view of the Downtown Dubai skyline anywhere in the city.

The only office address you will ever want

Ask any business leader to describe the perfect office location and they will describe this place. Transit at the door. A world-class mall downstairs. Hotels for visiting clients. Parks for clear thinking. Homes for your people. A waterfront for the evening. And a skyline view that reminds everyone, every day, what they are building.

Other districts will compete for tenants. Dubai Square Business District will choose them. The companies that move here first will not just lease space; they will claim a place at the centre of Dubai's next chapter.

Mohamed Alabbar, founder of Emaar, said: "We did not set out to build an office district. We set out to build the address every ambitious company in the world dreams of. Dubai Square is that address."

About Emaar Properties

Emaar Properties PJSC, listed on the Dubai Financial Market, is a global property developer and provider of premium lifestyles, witha significant presence in the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia. One of the world’s largest real estate companies, Emaar has a land bank of approximately 604 million sq. ft. in the UAE and key international markets.

With a proven track-record in delivery, Emaar has delivered over 132,800 residential units in Dubai and other global markets since 2002. Emaar has strong recurring revenue-generating assets with approximately 1.4 million sq. mtr. of leasing revenue-generatingassets and 42 hotels and resorts with  10,187 keys (includes owned as well as managed hotels). Today, around 25 percent of Emaar’s revenue is from its shopping malls, hospitality, leisure, entertainment, commercial leasing, and international businesses.

Burj Khalifa, a global icon, Dubai Mall, the world's most-visited retail and lifestyle destination, and Dubai Fountain, the world’s largest performing fountain, are among Emaar’s trophy destinations.
